e.title: 日内瓦协会（The Geneva Association）
e.title_en: The Geneva Association (global insurance think tank)
e.summary: 全球保险业智库：气候、人口健康、数字与 AI、网络风险四大研究主线 + 研究报告库
e.summary_en: Global insurance think tank: climate, population health, digital & AI and cyber research tracks, plus a research-report library
e.summary_hk: 全球保險業智庫：氣候、人口健康、數字與 AI、網絡風險四大研究主線 + 研究報告庫
e.body: 日内瓦协会（The Geneva Association，`genevaassociation.org`）自我定位为 **Global Insurance Think Tank**，是保险业最具影响力的国际研究机构（由全球主要保险公司 CEO 组成成员体系，现任主席为 Aegon CEO Lard Friese）。其研究主线清晰可辨，正好覆盖精算与保险业的中长期议题：**Macro & Geoeconomic Shifts**（宏观与地缘经济变迁）、**Climate Change & Environment**（气候变化与环境）、**Population Health Trends**（人口健康趋势）、**Digital & AI Transformation**（数字化与 AI 转型）、**Cyber**（网络风险）；出版侧有 **Research reports**、**Annual reports** 与 **Gen AI** 专题报告，并举办 Health & Demography Conference 等年度会议。对 RIAA：这是做**保险业宏观/战略级研究**时的首选高质量出处——它的报告通常给的是「行业级判断 + 数据」，而非单一公司的营销材料；气候主线可与 [[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[swiss-re-sigma]]、[[gdacs]] 搭配，人口健康主线与 [[mortality-table]]、[[excessmort]]、[[stmomo]] 对接，数字与 AI 主线可与 [[insurance-governance]]、[[iais-gimar]]、[[risk-radar-2026]] 对照；适合作研究型作业、行业报告写作与面试时的行业观点储备。
e.body_en: The Geneva Association (`genevaassociation.org`) describes itself as the **Global Insurance Think Tank** and is the insurance industry’s most influential international research body (its membership is drawn from the CEOs of leading insurers; its current chair is Aegon CEO Lard Friese). Its research tracks are clearly delineated and map onto the actuarial and insurance industry’s medium- and long-term agenda: **Macro & Geoeconomic Shifts**, **Climate Change & Environment**, **Population Health Trends**, **Digital & AI Transformation** and **Cyber**; on the publishing side there are **research reports**, **annual reports** and dedicated **Gen AI** reports, plus annual conferences such as the Health & Demography Conference. For RIAA: a first-choice high-quality source for **macro/strategic-level insurance research** — its reports typically offer industry-level judgement plus data rather than a single company’s marketing material; the climate track pairs with [[climate-conditioned-cat]], [[swiss-re-sigma]] and [[gdacs]]; the population-health track connects to [[mortality-table]], [[excessmort]] and [[stmomo]]; the digital and AI track can be read against [[insurance-governance]], [[iais-gimar]] and [[risk-radar-2026]]; suits research assignments, industry-report writing and building an industry viewpoint for interviews.
e.body_hk: 日內瓦協會（The Geneva Association，`genevaassociation.org`）自我定位為 **Global Insurance Think Tank**，是保險業最具影響力的國際研究機構（成員體系由全球主要保險公司 CEO 組成，現任主席為 Aegon CEO Lard Friese）。其研究主線清晰可辨，正好覆蓋精算與保險業的中長期議題：**Macro & Geoeconomic Shifts**、**Climate Change & Environment**、**Population Health Trends**、**Digital & AI Transformation**、**Cyber**；出版側有 **Research reports**、**Annual reports** 與 **Gen AI** 專題報告，並舉辦 Health & Demography Conference 等年度會議。對 RIAA：這是做**保險業宏觀/戰略級研究**時的首選高質量出處——報告通常給「行業級判斷 + 數據」，而非單一公司的營銷材料；氣候主線可與 [[climate-conditioned-cat]]、[[swiss-re-sigma]]、[[gdacs]] 搭配，人口健康主線與 [[mortality-table]]、[[excessmort]]、[[stmomo]] 對接，數字與 AI 主線可與 [[insurance-governance]]、[[iais-gimar]]、[[risk-radar-2026]] 對照；適合作研究型作業、行業報告寫作與面試時的行業觀點儲備。
